scripts.build: pnpm run build:design-system && pnpm run build:control-plane && pnpm run build:workbench
scripts.build:design-system: pnpm --filter @dataground/tokens build && pnpm --filter @dataground/ui build && pnpm --filter @dataground/ui storybook:build
scripts.format: biome check --write apps packages contracts scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json && gofmt -w cmd internal
scripts.format:check: biome format apps packages contracts scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json && node scripts/check-go-format.mjs
scripts.lint: biome lint apps packages contracts scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json && go vet ./...
scripts.test: go test ./... && pnpm --filter @dataground/tokens test && pnpm --filter @dataground/ui test && pnpm --filter @dataground/ui test:stories && pnpm --filter @dataground/workbench test
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run contracts:generate:check && pnpm run openshell:profile:check && pnpm run tokens:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
